description: > We are students from Yatiyantota, Sri Lanka. Team Yatiyantota Space Explorers. We are Grade 10 students excited to join NASA Space Apps Kandy 2025 virtually. Our mission is to build a fun Junior Astronaut Trainer for kids. We love space and want to make Sri Lanka Proud ♡
summary:
We are Maya Space Explorers, Grade 10 students. Our project "Mission Mars - Water Hunt: Build an Astronaut Journey" is a space-themed educational game set in 2035.

Our astronaut Maya travels to Mars to find water ice, because water is the key for humans to survive on Mars. We developed this using NASA data on Mars water ice.

How to play? Players help Maya collect 10 water ice pieces in 30 seconds while saving her oxygen. It is fun and challenging and teaches kids about Mars exploration.

Currently this is our prototype made with Scratch. In future we plan to add more levels, animations, and interactive features. Our simple goal is to make space learning fun for everyone.
details:
Our project MAYA SPACE EXPLORERS - MISSION MARS: WATER HUNT is an educational game made with Scratch.

What does it do / how does it work?
Maya explores Mars to find water. In our Scratch game, players help Maya to find water ice on Mars. They explore different places like Polar Ice Caps and Olympus Mons. When they find water, they win and learn how water is important for Mars life.

Benefits and Impact:
It helps kids learn about Mars in a fun way. Many kids don't know Mars has water ice. Our game makes space learning easy and fun for Sri Lankan students.

Tools we used:
- Scratch for making the game
- Google Slides for presentation
- NASA Mars images and information about Mars
- Google Meet for team discussion

Creativity:
We made a story with Maya character and made it as a Scratch game. So kids can play and learn at the same time.

Team considered:
We are school students and we wanted to make a simple and fun game. We focused on one main idea - finding water on Mars. We wanted to show that Mars is interesting and has water.
